knownLimitations: Summary Center's 五大區塊 are mostly empty for real uploads because MaterialParser/KnowledgeBuilder use Stub Implementation (no real PDF/document text extraction exists in this repo). Not a bug — reflects the repository's documented architecture (CLAUDE.md).

File preview/download on Home's Recent Material cards only works within the same browser session as the upload (File objects can't be persisted to sessionStorage) — MaterialFileStore mitigates this for bytes actually within the browser's storage quota.
